subject: South Street Local Historic District Recommendation
overview: The board recommended the establishment of a new local historic district on South Street and continued the review of a mixed-use development project at 290 Salem Street.

items.title: 290 Salem Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for a three-story building with seven residential units and ground-floor commercial space to May 1. The board requested revised renderings showing improved corner design treatments and sightline studies for the parking area.

items.title: Proposed South Street Local Historic District
items.summary: Recommended the creation of the South Street Local Historic District to the City Council to preserve 17 historic properties, including several associated with the city's shipbuilding history. The motion passes.

items.title: Minutes and Zoning Update
items.summary: Postponed the approval of minutes and updates on the zoning overhaul due to staff and member absences.
